title: Create your first commit
goal: Create notes.txt containing the exact line 'learning Git', stage it, and commit it on main.
hint: Git adds only staged changes to the next commit.

title: Stage one path, keep another unstaged
goal: Stage the edited notes.txt but keep config.txt modified and unstaged.
hint: Inspect git diff and git diff --cached.

title: Create a topic branch
goal: Create branch feature/readme; add a '## Usage' heading to README.md and commit it. Keep main unchanged.

title: Push to a local bare remote
goal: Push local main to the preconfigured local origin so both branch tips match.
hint: git push -u origin main; no internet required.

title: Fast-forward a feature
goal: Integrate feature/checklist into main by fast-forward (no merge commit).
hint: git switch main; git merge --ff-only feature/checklist

title: Resolve an actual merge conflict
goal: On main, merge feature/red, resolve settings.txt to 'color=purple', and finish a two-parent merge commit.
hint: Inspect conflict markers, edit, git add, git commit.

title: Revert a shared mistake
goal: Revert the last commit so status.txt returns to 'healthy'; preserve the bad commit in ancestry.

title: Cherry-pick one fix
goal: On maintenance, cherry-pick the latest fix from main without moving main.

title: Recover a misplaced commit
goal: Use reflog to identify the commit removed by reset, then create branch recovered-work pointing to it.

title: Locate a regression by bisect
goal: Find the first bad commit using git bisect; record its full 40/64-character Git hash in finding.txt. Reset bisect mode before grading.
hint: Known good: baseline commit; known bad: HEAD; test: python check.py

title: Use a linked worktree
goal: Create a worktree at the adjacent hotfix path on branch hotfix. Commit FIX.txt containing 'hotfix ready' in that worktree; main must remain untouched.

title: Make an annotated release tag
goal: Create annotated v1.0.0 tag on main's current commit with a meaningful release message.
